items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: somebody gave me a picture in San Francisco last week or the week before last, with him playing in some of the New Orleans band like Pichon’s band and all of them.

ctx.x: Evan Thomas. E-V-A-N. They may have called him Evan Thomas. But out in the country they called him Evan Thomas. He was supposed to be the trumpet player that Louis Armstrong was scared of. They tell me Louis Armstrong was more afraid of him than a pit of rattlesnakes. When Louis Armstrong got to Crowley he would pass it and go by. He was a hell of a player. Now he got killed before I was born but everybody being from Crowley, everybody used to talk about him and I found a picture, somebody gave me a picture in…
I bet he’s in that, I just read a book by Pops Foster.
